page.promise: Become the person people turn to.
page.lede: A proven method for helping people change their lives, and a certificate that shows you can. Study online, at your own pace, with no experience needed.

why.title: People are looking for someone like you.
paras: You are probably already the one friends call when life gets complicated. You listen well. You ask the question nobody else thought to ask. People leave a conversation with you feeling clearer than when they arrived.
Life coaching turns that instinct into a skill with a structure behind it, so you can do it on purpose, for people who need it, as your work.

points: A job that no longer fits and no idea what comes next
Starting again after a relationship ends
Knowing exactly what they want and never following through

why.title: Thoughts, feelings and actions are connected.
paras: CBT is one of the most widely used approaches to helping people change. Its central idea is simple: how we think affects how we feel, and how we feel affects what we do.
This course teaches you the model and its tools so you can use them in coaching conversations. It is a coaching certification. It does not license you to diagnose or treat mental health conditions.

page.promise: Help people write their way to clarity.
page.lede: Learn to use therapeutic writing with clients and groups, and earn a certificate that shows you can. Online, self-paced, no experience needed.

why.title: Some things are easier to write than to say.
paras: Putting words on a page slows thought down. People notice what they feel, see patterns and often surprise themselves with what comes out.
As a journal therapy coach you choose the right kind of writing for each person, guide them through it and help them make sense of what they find.
why.label: What clients come to journaling for
points: A busy mind that will not settle
Feelings they cannot put into spoken words
A decision they keep going round
Wanting to know themselves better

page.promise: Help sensitive people see it as a strength.
page.lede: Learn to coach highly sensitive people towards a life that suits how they are made. Online, self-paced, with a certificate at the end.

why.title: Nothing is wrong with feeling deeply.
paras: Some people notice more, feel more and tire sooner in a loud, fast world. Many have spent years being told they are too sensitive and believing it.
As an HSP coach you help them understand the trait, manage overwhelm and build a life around their strengths. Sensitivity is a trait, not a diagnosis, and this is coaching, not treatment.
why.label: What highly sensitive people come to a coach with
points: Feeling overwhelmed by noise, crowds or pressure
Absorbing other people's moods
Needing far more recovery time than others
Years of being told they are too much

list.q: Do I need to be highly sensitive myself?
list.a: No, though many HSP coaches are, and it can be a real advantage.

list.q: Is high sensitivity a medical condition?
list.a: No. It is a personality trait, and the course treats it that way.
